name: Role trust policy detected as role-trust and analyzed (supported)
note: IAM-801: Principal + only sts:AssumeRole and no Resource is the role-trust shape. It declares WHO may assume the role. The role-trust family is now SUPPORTED via the family-aware trust evaluator (engine/trust.js), so it is NOT blocked - it is routed to the trust analyzer, never the identity rules. A benign lambda service trust yields an informational TRUST-SERVICE relationship and no identity-escalation finding.
